vulnerability.name: CVE-2023-45853
vulnerability.description: MiniZip in zlib through 1.3 has an integer overflow and resultant heap-based buffer overflow in zipOpenNewFileInZip4_64 via a long filename, comment, or extra field.

statements.impact_statement: zt-payments runs on distroless Python runtime (FastAPI/uvicorn) and never invokes MiniZip archive creation functions. Ingress is restricted by Cilium L7 policy to POST /v1/charge from zt-orders only.
